title: System security and privacy plans need approved deployment scope and diagrams
remediation: The sponsor security and privacy owners approve planning policy and procedures, named responsibilities and the assessed boundary. Complete the system security and privacy plan with current component and trust-boundary diagrams, data flows, roles, requirements, shared responsibilities, exceptions and links to assessor evidence. Record review and release or deployment change triggers.

milestones.title: Collect the approved planning procedures, system security and privacy plan, reviewed deployment diagrams and linked evidence
